stance_rationale: PD25 has useful artifacts, but the primary package remains a draft with null metrics while the run artifacts show canonical Methodology A fails all 4 axes and all paths breach the base 600% turnover hard constraint. DSR, path-level 5-spec Harvey regression, and official weights.csv schedule verification are missing or mismatched, so this is not judge-ready.

critical_concerns.description: Primary forge_package_pd25_draft.json is stale: status is DRAFT_PENDING_CODEX and all metrics fields are null, while backtest_result_pd25 and challenge_note.md contain post-run results. The decision record is therefore not self-contained or judge-ready.

Canonical Methodology A rejects the design: Path A/B/C SR 1.10/1.11/1.11 vs S4 SR 1.814, CAGR lower by about 6pp, MDD worse by about 9-10pp, and 4axis_strict_improve.csv shows 0/4 axes for every path.

Methodology B flips the conclusion but is explicitly suspected of same-day timing leakage; first-trading-day-at-or-after signal-date pricing must be proven t-1/t+1 clean before any favorable RAWDATA result can be used.

Turnover hard constraint is breached under the base mandate: portfolio round-trip annual turnover is 793%, 843%, and 862% for A/B/C, all above the 600% hard cap. The challenge note reframes around v2.3 800%, but the required base context still states <600% hard.

No DSR penalty audit is present for the three tried weighting paths and baseline; candidates_tried × 0.05 is not applied consistently, so the favorable RAWDATA t-stat comparison has no multi-testing haircut.
PD25 path-level 5-spec Harvey regression is absent. Upstream risk_package has 5/5 specs for the original alpha, but not CAPM/C3/C4/FF5/FF6 alphas for Path A/B/C vs the PD25 portfolio returns.

Requested qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260511_001/weights.csv is missing, qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260511_001 is missing, and fallback weights schedules only cover 155 dates to 2023-11 while PD25 holdings cover 184 dates to 2026-04.

Rationalization phrases remain around coverage and pre-2011 substitution, especially 'acceptable since z_NEW=0' and 'out of PD25 scope'. These are not fatal by themselves, but they convert unmet 1991 coverage and schedule gaps into scope exceptions.

supporting_arguments: Pure function audit passes: alpha, risk, and optimization package md5_start equal md5_end.
alpha_scores.parquet fallback artifact is time-series, not single snapshot: 62,916 rows, 184 sig_dates from 2011-01-01 to 2026-04-01, 770 tickers.
covariance.parquet fallback artifact is PSD with min eigenvalue 0.01217 and condition number 8.81, satisfying cond <= 100 post-shrink.
period_returns.csv and nav.csv cover 255 monthly rows from 2005-02-01 to 2026-04-01; holdings.csv covers 184 active composite sig_dates.
Required charts for RF-F8 are present and non-empty: equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png.
unresolved_disputes: Whether Iter5 Ret_1m or RAWDATA close-to-close is the admissible PIT-safe return basis; the conclusion changes materially.
Whether the 600% hard turnover mandate is superseded by v2.3 800%; the required base context still says 600% hard.
Whether holdings.csv can substitute for the missing requested weights.csv schedule artifact.
Whether 71 pre-2011 months of S4 redistribution are a valid response to the user's 1991-2026 no-frozen mandate.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that Methodology A is the canonical PIT-safe basis while Methodology B is only a leakage suspect; this unresolved return-construction choice changes PD25 from reject/fail to apparent B/C dominance.
rebuttal_required: Publish a non-draft forge_package_pd25.json with populated metrics, RF flags, and explicit Methodology A/B reconciliation.
Produce path-level CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 regressions for Path A/B/C and S4 on the same period.
Apply and report DSR penalty consistently to all three candidate paths and the same-period baseline.
Provide the official weights.csv schedule or certify holdings.csv as the schedule artifact with 184 sig_dates through 2026-04.
Resolve PIT-C2/PIT-C9 for RAWDATA entry/exit timing with exact signal timestamp, execution timestamp, and price timestamp.
Apply the 600% turnover hard hurdle or cite the formal charter amendment that replaces it.
rationalization_red_flags: acceptable since z_NEW=0 makes B=C=A naturally
out of PD25 scope, separate WT 필요
Methodology A is the canonical PIT-safe basis

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Claude's own PD25 note reaches a provisional no-upgrade conclusion under Methodology A, but the stronger external issue is process validity: draft package, missing DSR, missing path-level 5-spec, turnover hard-fail, and schedule artifact mismatch prevent approval.
